title: Lab
description: Interactive pieces built to test ideas and show the working. First up: a history of search you can scroll, drag and be quizzed on.
headline: Things built to {play} with.
intro: A playground for ideas, interfaces and the odd bit of showing off. Each piece is small, finished and real.

pieces.title: A short history of search
pieces.note: Scroll from Archie to AI answers, drag a results page through 28 years, then take the quiz.

pieces.title: Deindexed
pieces.note: A site has vanished from Google. Three levels of real technical defects to find, with an inspector in the window and hints when you need them.
